approvals.reason: Pre-lock addition from #1682: a device can withdraw its pending sign-in request, and the approver's lookup reports it as cancelled. The bundled web approval page shows the state in the same change. The phone approvers (silo-android DevicePairingViewModel, silo-apple CompanionPairingCoordinator) don't branch on the lookup status, and when approving fails they show the 409 message, which says the device cancelled. The frozen v1 lookup reports such a request as expired.

Pre-lock addition from #1682: a device can withdraw its pending sign-in request, and a later poll reports it as cancelled. Only the device holding the device_code can cancel and poll, so the only client that sees the value is one that just called cancel; the TV sign-in fixes in silo-apple#553 and silo-android#420 add that call. The frozen v1 poll reports such a request as expired.
